answer: Sybil defence starts where capital stops working. Holding tokens buys no standing; only graded work on the glacier accrues. Every checkpoint root is anchored to a public chain and the full history replays for anyone. That makes each attestation permanently attributable: a pearl that vouched for junk is a timestamped record the audit lanes can act on later. So a ripple of identities is a subscription, not an acquisition: it bills the operator every epoch and refunds nothing when the panel disagrees. Seal 14l2f.
